create_cube_entity: create a cube entity with custom width, height, length, position, and rotation in the scene
create_sphere_entity: create a sphere entity with a given radius, position, rotation, and parent in the scene
create_cube_with_parent: create a cube entity and attach it as a child of an existing parent entity
create_sphere_with_parent: create a sphere entity and attach it as a child of an existing parent entity
create_default_cube: create a default unit cube entity at the origin with no rotation or parent
